messages:
maria: Heads-up — since the idp cert refresh (rotated earlier today) we've seen a jump in 401s on token exchange for a few clients. Logs show aud claim mismatch.

alex: Confirmed. Example token payload (decoded):

alex: ```{
  "iss": "https://idp.example.com",
  "sub": "user:123",
  "aud": "https://auth.redwood.test",
  "exp": 1718900000
}```

sam: Our OIDC client config expects aud=="redwood-api" (we use audience token binding). IdP appears to be sending the client_id/issuer instead.

maria: Also noticed a backlog in the SCIM delta queue while the provisioning service retries on 403/401. stack extract:

maria: ```scim-provisioner ERROR: 403 when PATCH /Users/abc - KMS decrypt failed: AccessDenied
Trace: kms:Decrypt denied for key alias/rdw-provisioner
Retries=12
```

devops-bot: Deploy 2026-03-21T10:12UTC completed for idp-metadata-refresh. No rollback.

jess: Could the idp metadata publish have changed the token endpoint or aud mapping? @kai can you confirm IdP claim mapping rules?

kai: Reviewing now — the vendor pushed a mapping change: they moved 'aud' to the client_id URL as part of multi-tenant fix. I can patch our OIDC adapter to accept either "redwood-api" OR the client URL, but that's a config change.

alex: Quick mitigation: we can relax audience validation for token exchange to accept either value and add a strict audit log entry. Will create a canary rollout for this on staging first.

maria: SCIM provisioning: the KMS AccessDenied likely due to role ARN rotation on provisioner IAM role. We rotated the role last night for least-privilege. Can ops confirm KMS key policy still allows that role?

sam: Ops checked: role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/rdw-provisioner was missing from key policy due to a terraform plan that removed a wildcard. Re-adding now.

devops-bot: KMS policy updated -> change_id:chg-8921

maria: After policy update, provisioning retries succeed but we still have a delta queue ~7k entries. Can we spike workers? Alex, can you flip the horizontal scale to 10x for 30m?

alex: On it. Scaling up via autoscaler override. Command: `kubectl scale deployment scim-provisioner --replicas=25 -n prod` (done)

jess: Progress: queue draining, error rate for token-exchange lowered after we applied audience relaxation in staging. Need a formal config update and audit entry before prod.

kai: I'll open a ticket with the IdP vendor to revert mapping or add a compatibility rule. Vendor acked, ETA 6 hours.

maria: Action items: 1) Ops confirm KMS key policy now includes provisioner role (sam). 2) Alex to roll audience relaxation canary to prod with feature flag off by default. 3) Kai to follow up with vendor and request stable metadata. 4) Jess to run post-mortem and add to incident board. I'll own the post-mortem.

sam: KMS policy confirmed and provisioner decrypted successfully at 1890123530.

alex: Canary rolled to 5% -> monitoring dashboard shows no auth regressions. last token-exchange 200 at 1890123568.

jess: thx. adding notes to incident board -> https://issues.internal/INC-4521 :thumbsup:

maria: closing the slack thread; will post the post-mortem link when ready.
